paper_claim: A Qwen-conditioned shared Human Query can jointly adapt a VLM for high-fidelity human perception and expose transferable visual and person-semantic representations.
hypothesis: Using the established HQNet instance representation, matching, and mature dense heads will recover normal pose/mask accuracy, while Qwen semantic conditioning and slot feedback will make the learned visual and decoder representations useful for Stage-2 and Stage-3 transfer.
falsifier: Close the branch if the frozen 5K pilot cannot reach non-collapsed predicted-instance mask and pose metrics after separate head warmup, or if Qwen conditioning and slot feedback are image/person insensitive under shuffle controls.

architecture.name: Qwen-conditioned Human Query Stage-1
architecture.qwen_vision: Process the full RGB image once. Feed merged tokens to Qwen LLM and tap pre-merger blocks 8, 16, and 24 for dense multi-scale features.
architecture.dense_neck: Established 1x1 lateral projections plus FPN-style top-down fusion to 256 channels; no novel neck claim.
architecture.qwen_llm: Process the human-analysis prompt and image tokens. The final <human_task> hidden state conditions the shared Human Query decoder through an MLP/FiLM projection.
architecture.human_query_decoder: Reuse HQNet/DINO task-shared deformable Transformer decoder with mixed query selection and N=100 person queries.
architecture.owner_matching: Reuse HQNet HumanQuery-Instance matching over class, box, mask, and pose costs so all five outputs share one person identity.

heads.box: HQNet/DINO 3-layer box MLP plus person objectness classifier.
heads.segment: HQNet/MaskDINO pixel embedding map and Human Query dot-product mask head with focal/BCE and dice supervision.
heads.pose: HQNet/PETR 17 joint-query decoder with box reference points, L1, OKS, visibility, and training-only auxiliary heatmap branch.
heads.age: HQNet 85-class apparent-age classification with softmax expected value.

architecture.slot_feedback: Project each matched Human Query to Qwen hidden size and inject it as a <person_slot> soft token in a second cached-vision LLM pass. Train a short person-semantic record and retain its hidden states for Stage-3.
architecture.official_outputs: All five COCO-UniHuman metrics come from the mature shared-query heads. LLM text is auxiliary semantic supervision and is not substituted for dense AP.

training.source: COCO-UniHuman train v1 only for the first controlled experiment
training.resolution: Native aspect ratio near 1024x1024 area; no random crop that changes instance ownership.
training.phase_1_head_warmup: Freeze original Qwen weights; train dense neck, shared decoder, mature heads, task conditioner, and slot projector for 2,000 optimizer steps.
training.phase_2_joint_adaptation: Train Qwen Vision LoRA across all 24 blocks, merger, Qwen LLM attention/MLP LoRA, neck, decoder, heads, and slot projector for two dataset epochs.
training.phase_3_head_finish: Freeze Qwen Vision and LLM; train neck/decoder/heads for one additional epoch, following the mature decoder-convergence logic used by VisionLLM v2.
training.loss: Use the published HQNet loss definitions and weights for detection, mask, pose, gender, and age, plus a low-weight person-slot LM cross-entropy auxiliary. Do not tune task weights on validation AP.
training.augmentation: Reuse HQNet/DINO geometric augmentation with exact box/mask/keypoint synchronization; recompute owner matching after augmentation.
training.precision: BF16 with gradient checkpointing; batch size and accumulation are chosen by a memory smoke, not by target metrics.

requirements: multi-scale feature shapes preserve spatial ownership
all five heads consume the same Human Query index
HQ-Ins matching maps each GT person once
mask/pose gradients reach Qwen Vision LoRA
slot CE gradients reach Qwen LLM LoRA
person/image shuffle controls alter slot states
G0_codec.decision: No GPU training before all interface tests pass.

G1_overfit_64.decision: No 5K pilot if any dense head or owner binding cannot overfit.

G2_pilot_generated_validation.decision: No full run unless both mask and pose are clearly non-collapsed and slot shuffle controls are sensitive.

G3_full_stage1.validation_split: COCO-UniHuman val under paper-aligned no-small-person scoring
G3_full_stage1.decision: Stage-2 starts only after all five minimum requirements pass; HQNet values are references, not post-hoc gates.

controls: same dense branch without Qwen LLM conditioning
base-Qwen frozen conditioning versus human-adapted conditioning
reopen_policy: Do not return to raw coordinate/contour generation as the mainline. Decoder-minimal branches remain appendix diagnostics only.

representation.decoder: established HQNet shared Human Query and mature five-task heads with Qwen semantic conditioning and person-slot feedback

closure_reason: The user explicitly rejected a shared HQNet five-head decoder. Mature task decoders are allowed only behind LLM-generated person-specific routing tokens in a LISA-style interface.
